name: geoatlas
description: ГеоАтлас — визуализатор сетевых взаимодействий по syslog МСЭ: парсинг, GeoIP, карта связей, аномалии, ClickHouse.

fields.dco_justification: DCO 1.1 required (git commit -s); enforced by https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml — see https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
fields.bus_factor_justification: // Single maintainer today (bus factor 1). Target >=2 documented in https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
fields.documentation_current_justification: Docs updated with releases; defects tracked via Issues: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/README.md
fields.accessibility_best_practices_justificati: // No dedicated accessibility program yet; improvements accepted via Issues.
fields.internationalization_justification: // Operator UI is Russian-first without an i18n framework yet.
fields.sites_password_security_justification: Project site/repo authentication is GitHub; we do not store end-user passwords for bestpractices/GitHub pages.
fields.maintenance_or_update_justification: Upgrade path: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/operations.md — supported release policy in SECURITY.md
fields.vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: No vulnerability reports resolved in the last 12 months; credit policy in https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/SECURITY.md
fields.build_standard_variables_justification: Primary distribution is Docker images / compose, not a native CC/CFLAGS install toolchain.
fields.build_preserve_debug_justification: No native install -s stripping path; container images built in CI.
fields.build_non_recursive_justification: Go modules / npm / Docker; no recursive make with cross-directory cycles.
fields.build_repeatable_justification: Pinned base images and lockfiles; release tarball from CI: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-tag.yml
fields.installation_standard_variables_justific: Install via OS scripts into /opt/geoatlas; not DESTDIR-based POSIX make install.
fields.updateable_reused_components_justificati: Dependencies updated via Go modules and npm lockfile.
fields.interfaces_current_justification: Stack kept on supported Go/Node; obsolete APIs avoided in project code.
fields.test_statement_coverage80_justification: Go statement coverage >=80% enforced in CI (coverage overall step): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml — tracked in https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/openssf-silver.md
fields.crypto_weaknesses_justification: bcrypt passwords; TLS at nginx; no MD5/DES/RC4 defaults: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/security-requirements.md
fields.crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: TLS configuration at nginx edge can use modern cipher suites; app uses standard library crypto.
fields.crypto_credential_agility_justification: Secrets in .env / files under /app/data, replaceable without rebuild: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
fields.crypto_used_network_justification: HTTPS optional but recommended for UI; insecure syslog :514 is an explicit accepted limit documented for operators.
fields.crypto_tls12_justification: When HTTPS enabled, nginx modern TLS (1.2+): https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/install.md
fields.crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Outbound reputation fetch uses TLS with certificate verification (Go default); safeurl restricts targets.
fields.crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Appliance does not send private cookies to arbitrary third parties over TLS as a browser-like client.
fields.signed_releases_justification: cosign keyless on release tarball; verify steps: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/install.md https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/RELEASING.md
fields.version_tags_signed_justification: // Release artifacts are cosign-signed; git tags are annotated but not GPG-signed.
fields.hardening_justification: Proxy gate, rate limit, security headers: https://github.com/varlahin-gena/geoatlas/blob/main/docs/configuration.md
